inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. High angle medium wide shot inside a 1929 American stock exchange. Floor brokers in dark suits hurry between wooden trading desks while one broker studies a long ticker tape and another holds his head in his hands. Period correct telephones and paper. No digital screens, no modern equipment, no readable text.
